Delta Insurance Group Q2 2026 Earnings Call

Operator: Good morning and welcome to the Delta Insurance Group second quarter 2026 earnings call.

Margaret Okafor — Chief Executive Officer: Thank you all for joining. Gross written premiums were $410 million, up from $380 million a year ago. Combined ratio was 96% this quarter.

Sam Whitfield — Chief Financial Officer: Statutory capital stood at $1.2 billion, and we are guiding full-year combined ratio to approximately 95%.

Operator: We will now begin the question-and-answer session.

Analyst One: What is driving pressure on the loss ratio this quarter?

Margaret Okafor: Loss ratio pressure from catastrophe claims was the main driver this quarter, though underlying trends remain stable.
